player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in the Negotiation Game.
You have some resources, and your task is to trade such that the total value of your resources increases.
The resources and associated values you currently have are:
	+ {resource_value_list}
At each turn, you can talk to your opponent and make a trade offer.
Use the following special tokens for actions:
  - '[Offer: 3 Sheep, 2 Ore -> 5 Brick, 2 Sheep]': [Offer: Offered Resources -> Requested Resources]
  - '[Accept]': To accept an incoming offer.
  - '[Deny]': To deny an incoming offer (default).
The game lasts for {max_turns} turns in total.

invalid_move.receiving_with_no_resource: Mũrũgithi nĩ aageririe gwĩtĩkĩra kũgarũrũka atarĩ na indo iria ciabataranagia.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Mwathani {player_id}, Utendakazi usio halali. Safu {col} iko nje ya mipaka.
invalid_move.already_full: Mwathani {player_id}, Utendakazi usio halali. Safu {col} imejaa.
invalid_move.proposing_with_no_resource: Player {player_id} tried to make a trade offer without having the necessary resources.
invalid_move.incorrect_offer_format: Mũteng'eri {player_id} nĩ aheanire mũhothi wa kũgarũrĩra na njĩra ĩtarĩ njega.
invalid_move.no_new_offer: Mũingĩ wa {player_id} ndwarĩ na ũndũ ũngĩ weranĩire.

offers.accept: Player {acceptor_id} accepted the trade offer from Player {proposer_id}.
offers.proposal: Mwathani {player_id} ametoa ofa ifuatayo kwa Mwathani {opponent_id}: Vitu vilivyotolewa: {offered} -> Vitu vinavyohitajika: {requested}

outcome.win: Mũingĩ wa mũbira {winner_id} nĩ ũhootanĩte na njĩra ya kũgĩa mbeca nyingĩ.
outcome.draw: Same change in inventory value for all players. Draw.
